description: Build a buy preview (curve, or the PancakeSwap pool once graduated). Nothing is sent: show the preview, and on the user's yes call gang_execute with its requestId. amount = what to pay, in the token's quote.

note.description: Public, permanent reason for the trade (1-280 chars, no links). Mainnet curve trades only

payBnb.description: Pool buy of a token quoted in another token: pay BNB (BNB -> quote -> token)

ref.description: Who invited this wallet (0x address or .ai handle), only one the user gave: counts on its first Gang trade

revealAfter.description: Seal the note for 1-72 hours, e.g. "6h"

testnet.description: BSC testnet GangLaunchpad (tokens have no value)

useQuote.description: Pool buy of a WBNB-quoted token: pay WBNB

useWbnb.description: Curve buy of a WBNB-quoted token: pay WBNB instead of BNB
